difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a canonical morphism of complexes from the total complex of the tensor product of a complex with an internal hom complex into the internal hom complex of the third complex with the total tensor complex, functorial in all three variables. As in the companion lemma, the author first notes that the map follows from the monoidal adjunction and then gives a direct construction: a degree n element of the target is expanded as a family of maps into the graded pieces of the total tensor complex, the differential of each component is computed from the sign rules, the same is done for a degree n element of the source written as a finite sum of tensor products, and the map is defined componentwise through the canonical map from a tensor product of a module with a hom module. The proof closes by checking well-definedness through a finiteness condition and compatibility with differentials by comparing signs.
